bites.title: Australia warns that entry-level jobs may go first to AI
bites.en: Australia has launched a best practice guide on AI at work, after job cuts at Qantas and Canva. It says entry-level jobs will be the first to be automated. AI could bring shorter hours and higher pay, or more burnout and surveillance.
bites.ko: 호주가 AI 활용 지침을 내놓으며 신입 일자리가 가장 먼저 자동화될 수 있다고 말했어요.

bites.title: Nine Korean startups want a place at Disrupt 2027
bites.en: Nine Korean startups are competing for a spot in the Startup Battlefield 200 at Disrupt 2027. They work in deep tech, including health care, fintech, energy, chips, and AI. All nine want to enter the U.S. market.
bites.ko: 한국 스타트업 아홉 곳이 디스럽트 2027 스타트업 배틀필드 200 진출을 노려요.

bites.title: Norwest raises its biggest fund yet
bites.en: The investment firm Norwest has raised a new $4 billion fund. It is the largest fund the firm has ever had. Norwest says it will go deeper into AI.
bites.ko: 투자사 노웨스트가 40억 달러 규모의 역대 최대 펀드를 만들고 AI 투자를 늘려요.

bites.title: Economist warns that an AI bubble could hurt Korea
bites.en: Economist Kenneth Rogoff says an AI bubble will burst at some point. He warned that it would be very painful, and that Korea could be hit especially hard. He urged policymakers to prepare for more economic ups and downs.
bites.ko: 로고프 교수는 AI 거품이 꺼지면 한국이 특히 크게 흔들릴 수 있다고 경고했어요.

bites.title: Flood protection can raise costs for poorer residents
bites.en: A University of Copenhagen study says climate adaptation can make inequality worse. In Copenhagen, the costs of stormwater protection fall more heavily on poorer residents. The study looked at how the costs are shared.
bites.ko: 코펜하겐 연구에 따르면 기후 적응 비용이 가난한 주민에게 더 크게 돌아가요.

bites.title: Burberry returns to profit
bites.en: Burberry is making a profit again after a back-to-basics plan. Its coats, jackets and handbags sold well. The CEO says a democratic approach helped the brand.
bites.ko: 버버리가 기본으로 돌아간 전략으로 다시 흑자를 냈어요.

bites.title: Earnings calls still teach investors something new
bites.en: A Finnish doctoral study looked at the question-and-answer parts of company earnings calls. The language used there can be hard for ordinary investors to follow. Even so, these sessions give useful information that written reports do not.
bites.ko: 실적 발표 질의응답은 개인 투자자에겐 어렵지만 보고서에 없는 정보를 준다는 연구예요.

bites.title: UK carmakers ask the EU to delay electric car tariffs
bites.en: The UK car industry wants a two-year delay to new tariffs on electric cars traded with the EU. The EU first suggested a shorter delay. Rules of origin for vehicle batteries are due to start on 1 January without a deal.
bites.ko: 영국 자동차 업계가 EU와의 전기차 관세를 2년 늦춰 달라고 요구해요.

bites.title: US city workers push back against AI at work
bites.en: Public workers in the US are fighting to protect their jobs from AI. In Oakland, California, city workers worry that AI could increase surveillance and judge their work unfairly. Some workers are winning safeguards.
bites.ko: 미국 공공 노동자들이 AI로부터 일자리를 지키려 싸우고 있고, 일부는 보호 장치를 얻어 내고 있어요.

bites.title: AI chatbots point shoppers to fake websites
bites.en: A new study found that AI chatbots can send shoppers to imposters and other risky websites. The test used ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity with shopping questions. The study was done by the IP protection firm Podqi.
bites.ko: 챗GPT·제미나이·퍼플렉시티가 쇼핑 질문에 가짜 사이트를 추천할 수 있다는 연구가 나왔어요.

bites.title: Cheap phones may use recycled memory chips
bites.en: Memory chip prices are soaring. Some budget phone makers are now using secondhand chips taken from old phones or scrapped circuit boards. TrendForce says recycled memory could be used in 7 to 9 percent of smartphones shipped in 2027.
bites.ko: 메모리 값이 치솟자 일부 저가 폰이 중고 칩을 재활용해요. 전체 폰의 7~9퍼센트까지 쓰일 수 있어요.

bites.title: Ring's home drone has no manual controls
bites.en: Ring's camera drone will fly only with an AI pilot. Users cannot control it by hand. It follows set routes and avoids obstacles by itself.
bites.ko: 링의 집 안 카메라 드론은 수동 조종 없이 AI 조종사만으로 날아요.

bites.title: More game developers now use generative AI
bites.en: A yearly survey by the GDC Festival of Gaming found more developers using generative AI at work. Forty percent say they use it as part of their job. That is up from 36 percent in 2025.
bites.ko: GDC 설문에서 게임 개발자의 40퍼센트가 업무에 생성형 AI를 쓴다고 답했어요. 작년엔 36퍼센트였어요.

bites.title: Hackers reached Notion chats through Fireworks AI
bites.en: A cyberattack on Fireworks AI let hackers see chat transcripts from Notion customers. This is the second data breach at Fireworks in two months.
bites.ko: 해커가 파이어웍스 AI를 공격해 노션 고객의 채팅 기록에 접근했어요. 두 달 새 두 번째 유출이에요.

bites.title: Google Wallet can now unlock smart locks
bites.en: Google Wallet now supports digital home keys. Android users can open smart locks by tapping their phone on the lock or just walking up to it. It is in public preview now and will reach everyone in the coming weeks.
bites.ko: 구글 월렛이 디지털 집 열쇠를 지원해서 폰을 대기만 해도 스마트 도어락을 열 수 있어요.

bites.title: Whoop launches a social network for health data
bites.en: Whoop has launched a social network. Members can share their sleep, recovery, and workout data. The CEO hinted that the company may make acquisitions to become a personal health brand.
bites.ko: 웨어러블 회사 웁이 수면·운동 기록을 나누는 소셜 네트워크를 열었어요.

bites.title: Databricks AI agent gives the CEO honest answers
bites.en: Databricks has 12,000 employees, so its CEO cannot know everyone. He uses its updated Genie agent to learn what is going wrong in the company.
bites.ko: 데이터브릭스 CEO는 새 AI 에이전트 Genie로 회사의 문제를 솔직하게 듣고 있어요.

bites.title: Microsoft Outlook goes down for many users
bites.en: Outlook email had an outage for users in several regions. People could not open their mail on the web or in apps. Microsoft said part of its infrastructure was under heavy load across multiple regions.
bites.ko: 마이크로소프트 아웃룩이 여러 지역에서 먹통이 됐어요. 회사는 일부 시스템에 부하가 걸렸다고 밝혔어요.

bites.title: Nissan cuts petrol car output as China goes electric
bites.en: Nissan will make fewer petrol cars. It says the shift to new energy vehicles in China is happening faster than expected. The company slashed its sales forecasts for China amid a brutal price war.
bites.ko: 닛산이 중국 전기차 전환이 예상보다 빨라 휘발유차 생산을 줄이고 중국 판매 전망도 낮췄어요.

bites.title: A new way to make dense ceramic films at lower heat
bites.en: Ceramic films are used in solid-state batteries and other devices. Making them usually needs very high heat, which can cause problems. A new liquid-phase growth method makes dense, even films at a lower temperature.
bites.ko: 고체 배터리 등에 쓰는 세라믹 막을 낮은 온도에서도 촘촘하게 만드는 새 방법이 나왔어요.

bites.title: Sweden builds a wooden data centre
bites.en: A data centre in Falun, Sweden, is built of wood and looks like a very large Ikea. It runs on fully renewable power. It was designed with the local community in mind.
bites.ko: 스웨덴 팔룬의 데이터센터는 나무로 지었고 재생에너지만 써요. 지역 주민을 생각해 설계했어요.

bites.title: Lemon waste can become flexible bioplastic
bites.en: Researchers used leftovers from the lemon industry to make a bioplastic called PHBV. The new material is more flexible than a commercial version. The study was published in the journal Polymers.
bites.ko: 레몬 가공 부산물로 만든 바이오플라스틱이 시판 제품보다 더 유연하다는 연구예요.

bites.title: SoftBank loses over $3 billion on gas turbines
bites.en: SoftBank lost more than $3 billion after it preordered natural gas turbines to power AI data centers. TechCrunch says the loss may limit AI's appetite for natural gas.
bites.ko: 소프트뱅크가 AI 데이터센터용 가스터빈을 선주문했다가 30억 달러 넘게 잃었어요.

bites.title: Korean shipbuilders eye US Navy warship work
bites.en: Korean shipyards may get a chance to build warships for the US Navy. The plan would let allied yards build the first one or two ships at home. A political shake-up in Washington could complicate the plan.
bites.ko: 한국 조선소가 미 해군 군함 건조에 참여할 기회를 노리지만 미국 정치 변화가 변수예요.

bites.title: Lumina simulates the universe leaving its dark age
bites.en: A new supercomputer simulation called Lumina shows how the universe left its cosmic dark age. It recreates 2 billion years of early history across a region 1.6 billion light-years wide.
bites.ko: 새 시뮬레이션 루미나가 우주가 암흑기를 벗어나 별과 은하로 채워지는 과정을 보여 줘요.

bites.title: A quantum computer stores memory in tiny vibrations
bites.en: Researchers built a quantum computer that stores information in tiny vibrations. These vibrations are like a guitar string. The design could make quantum machines smaller and better at keeping information.
bites.ko: 작은 진동에 정보를 저장하는 양자컴퓨터가 나왔고, 더 작고 정보를 잘 지키는 기계로 이어질 수 있어요.

bites.title: Scientists explain how graphite turns into diamond
bites.en: Under high pressure, graphite first turns into lonsdaleite, a hexagonal form of diamond. It does not become the familiar cubic diamond first. Researchers in Russia worked out why this happens.
bites.ko: 흑연이 높은 압력에서 보통 다이아몬드가 아닌 육각형 론스달라이트로 먼저 변하는 이유를 밝혔어요.

bites.title: Toxic forever chemicals fall in England's rivers
bites.en: Levels of toxic forever chemicals have dropped a lot in England's rivers. The BBC reports that the fall is put down to strict limits on how the substances can be used.
bites.ko: 영국 강에서 독성 '영원한 화학물질' 농도가 크게 줄었고, 사용 제한 덕분으로 보여요.

bites.title: A simple rule may explain how hair grows in patterns
bites.en: Scientists found that hair follicle patterns may come from a simple process. Cells follow chemical signals. This challenges an old theory and shows nature can build complex patterns without a detailed blueprint.
bites.ko: 머리카락 모낭의 무늬가 세포가 화학 신호를 따르는 단순한 과정에서 생길 수 있다고 해요.

bites.title: Kelp can reproduce alone when no mates are near
bites.en: A study found that kelp can switch between sexual and asexual reproduction. They choose based on whether mates are nearby. The work was published on Nov. 12 in PLOS Biology.
bites.ko: 다시마류는 짝이 가까이 있는지에 따라 유성·무성 번식을 바꾼다는 연구가 나왔어요.

bites.title: Antarctic ozone hole is the seventh largest on record
bites.en: NASA says the 2026 ozone hole is the seventh largest ever. Unusual weather pushed it near its maximum. Limits on harmful chemicals stopped it from growing more.
bites.ko: 올해 남극 오존 구멍이 역대 7번째 크기가 됐지만 규제 덕에 더 커지진 않았어요.

bites.title: MIT builds faster AI models for climate prediction
bites.en: MIT scientists created a training method for models that simulate how human activity affects climate. These models run much faster than other methods.
bites.ko: MIT가 인간 활동이 기후에 미치는 영향을 훨씬 빠르게 모사하는 AI 모델 훈련법을 개발했어요.

bites.title: Climate change tripled the odds of Iberia's fire weather
bites.en: A wildfire report says the extreme fire weather in Spain and Portugal in 2025 was three times more likely because of human-caused climate change.
bites.ko: 2025년 이베리아반도의 극심한 산불 날씨는 기후변화로 발생 가능성이 3배 높아졌어요.

bites.title: Rain may help the ocean absorb more carbon
bites.en: Global carbon budgets may underestimate ocean carbon uptake by about 5 to 15 percent. Current estimates do not fully count the effects of rain on the ocean surface.
bites.ko: 비가 바다 표면에 미치는 영향 때문에 바다의 탄소 흡수량이 5~15퍼센트 과소평가됐을 수 있어요.

bites.title: Early land animals had stiff necks
bites.en: The first animals to walk on land, about 380 million years ago, had stiff necks. This overturns an old theory. Necks may have appeared as animals began to move using their front limbs.
bites.ko: 약 3억 8천만 년 전 첫 육상 동물의 목은 뻣뻣했어요. 목은 앞다리 이동과 함께 생겼을 수 있어요.

bites.title: Proteins in Homo naledi teeth point to a female burial site
bites.en: Researchers studied ancient proteins in the teeth of Homo naledi, an extinct human relative. They found no male-specific markers in at least 20 individuals. This may explain an all-female burial site in a South African cave.
bites.ko: 호모 날레디 치아 단백질에서 남성 표지가 없어 이 동굴이 여성 매장지였을 수 있어요.

bites.title: Asian elephants are becoming more isolated
bites.en: A new study finds that Asian elephants are increasingly isolated. Their social networks are breaking up. Elephants do best in groups that work together to find food and care for their young.
bites.ko: 아시아코끼리가 점점 고립되며 사회 관계망이 쪼개지고 있다는 연구예요.

bites.title: RSV shots are cutting hospital stays
bites.en: Vaccines and antibody injections against RSV are cutting hospitalizations linked to the virus. Nature reports that new data show the shots work very well.
bites.ko: RSV 백신과 항체 주사 덕분에 이 바이러스로 입원하는 사람이 줄고 있어요.

bites.title: A blood clue may reveal early ovarian cancer
bites.en: Researchers found a molecular signal in the blood. It points to tiny changes that appear before ovarian cancer develops. The disease is often found only after it has already spread.
bites.ko: 혈액 속 분자 신호가 난소암이 생기기 전의 작은 변화를 알려 줄 수 있다는 연구가 나왔어요.

bites.title: Strong cold pills can cost 20 times more
bites.en: Some cold and flu remedies cost 20 times as much as a basic pack of paracetamol or ibuprofen. BBC News asks whether the extra money is worth it.
bites.ko: 일부 감기약은 기본 해열진통제보다 20배 비싸요. BBC가 그 값어치가 있는지 따져 봤어요.

bites.title: Scientists map a brain area tied to many diseases
bites.en: A global team studied nearly 26 million cells from the basal ganglia, a part of the brain. They built a database that compares species. It should help study illnesses from Parkinson's disease to addiction.
bites.ko: 국제 연구팀이 뇌의 기저핵 세포 약 2,600만 개를 분석해 파킨슨병부터 중독까지 연구할 자료를 만들었어요.

bites.title: A guide to the therapy words teens use
bites.en: Words once heard mostly in a therapist's room are now part of everyday talk. BBC News offers parents a guide to understanding what their teenagers mean when they use them.
bites.ko: 상담실에서나 쓰던 말이 일상 대화에 퍼졌고, BBC가 부모를 위한 해설을 내놨어요.

bites.title: Fast, sudden sports may build stronger bones
bites.en: A new study found that walking, jogging and normal weight training may not help bones as much as explosive sports. Football and handball raised markers of bone formation by up to 46%.
bites.ko: 걷기나 일반 근력 운동보다 축구·핸드볼 같은 폭발적인 운동이 뼈 형성에 더 좋을 수 있어요.

bites.title: Fructose may help cancer cells spread
bites.en: Scientists found that fructose, a sugar in sweet foods and drinks, may help aggressive ovarian cancer spread. Cancer cells that survive chemotherapy release fructose. This weakens the bonds that hold nearby tumor cells together.
bites.ko: 과당이 항암 치료 뒤 살아남은 난소암 세포가 퍼지는 것을 도울 수 있다는 연구가 나왔어요.

bites.title: UK watchdog tells sunbed firms to stop downplaying cancer
bites.en: The advertising watchdog says sunbed companies must not play down the risk of cancer. They also must not claim that sunbeds can treat skin conditions or improve mental health.
bites.ko: 영국 광고 감독 기관은 태닝 업체가 암 위험을 줄여 말하거나 치료 효과를 내세우면 안 된다고 했어요.

bites.title: Tiny cracks may help a coating kill superbugs
bites.en: Antibiotic resistance is rising. Scientists at Flinders University found that very small cracks can make an antibacterial coating work better. The coating kills dangerous bacteria when it gets a small electric charge.
bites.ko: 미세한 균열이 전기 자극을 받는 항균 코팅의 살균 효과를 높일 수 있다는 연구가 나왔어요.

bites.title: Haiti's fight against gangs relies on foreign forces
bites.en: El Salvador is exporting its 'Bukele model' to Haiti. Haiti's war on gangs now depends on foreign troops and private militias. The Conversation says this makes accountability harder.
bites.ko: 아이티의 갱단 소탕이 외국 군대와 민간 무장 조직에 기대면서 책임을 묻기 어려워졌다고 해요.

bites.title: Argentina tells a tribunal Britain cannot claim the sea
bites.en: In a Falklands oil case in Hamburg, an Argentine lawyer said Britain should not act like a 17th-century colonial power. He rejected the idea that the crown has sovereignty over parts of the oceans.
bites.ko: 아르헨티나 측 변호사가 함부르크 재판소에서 영국의 해양 주권 주장을 반박했어요.

bites.title: Illinois bans THC drinks and sellers rush to clear stock
bites.en: At midnight on Thursday, hemp-based THC drinks became illegal in Illinois. Companies are rushing to sell their remaining stock or ship it to states with different rules, such as Wisconsin and Tennessee.
bites.ko: 일리노이에서 대마 성분 THC 음료가 불법이 되자 업체들이 재고를 서둘러 팔거나 다른 주로 보내고 있어요.

bites.title: Finland will bar Russian athletes
bites.en: Finland says it will limit entry for Russian athletes because of the war in Ukraine. Skating and cross-country skiing would be the first sports affected. The move follows a backlash over Russia's return to ice hockey events.
bites.ko: 핀란드가 우크라이나 전쟁을 이유로 러시아 선수의 입국을 제한하겠다고 했어요.

bites.title: Freed death row inmates ask Florida to stop executions
bites.en: Three men who were once on death row in Florida asked the next governor, Byron Donalds, to stop executions. Florida plans its 20th execution of the year next week, and 235 prisoners are now condemned.
bites.ko: 플로리다에서 사형수였다가 풀려난 세 사람이 다음 주지사에게 사형 집행 중단을 요청했어요.

bites.title: Amnesty says UN peacekeepers missed warnings in South Sudan
bites.en: Amnesty International says UN peacekeepers and South Sudan's authorities did too little after warnings. Weeks later, insurgents raided a village and killed more than 200 people.
bites.ko: 국제앰네스티는 남수단 학살 전에 경고가 있었는데 유엔 평화유지군이 충분히 대응하지 않았다고 했어요.

bites.title: A judge lets Trump's $10 billion case against the BBC go on
bites.en: A federal judge ruled that Trump's defamation lawsuit against the BBC can continue. The judge turned down part of the BBC's request to dismiss it. The case is about how a program was edited.
bites.ko: 미 연방판사가 트럼프의 BBC 상대 100억 달러 명예훼손 소송을 계속 진행하도록 허용했어요.

bites.title: A lost teenager is found alive after six days
bites.en: A 17-year-old named William went missing near Walhalla in Victoria, Australia. After almost a week, a police air wing found him lying in a creek. He then had an emotional reunion with his mother.
bites.ko: 호주 빅토리아주 숲에서 엿새 동안 실종됐던 17세 소년이 경찰 항공대에 발견돼 어머니와 만났어요.

bites.title: A Roman fort in Wales revives an old legend
bites.en: Archaeologists found a Roman timber fort in the Preseli hills of Pembrokeshire, Wales. The find has brought a medieval Welsh legend about an emperor back into focus.
bites.ko: 웨일스 프레셀리 언덕에서 로마 목조 요새가 발견되어 중세 웨일스 전설이 다시 주목받고 있어요.

bites.title: A study finds scientists disagree on what science is
bites.en: A study in Royal Society Open Science asked scientists about science itself. It found that they hold surprisingly different ideas. They disagree about its meaning.
bites.ko: 과학자들도 과학이 무엇인지에 대해 생각이 서로 꽤 다르다는 연구가 나왔어요.

bites.title: An Indian mega library faces a scandal over AI-generated books
bites.en: Tamil Nadu has a new large library in India. A scandal says some books may be made by AI. The state government ordered an internal audit of library collections.
bites.ko: 인도 타밀나두의 대형 도서관에 AI가 쓴 책 논란이 일어 주 정부가 장서 내부 감사를 명령했어요.

bites.title: UK councils own over 500,000 artworks, but most are in storage
bites.en: The BBC found that 225 councils own more than 500,000 pieces of art. Most of it is kept in storage. Only some is on display.
bites.ko: 영국 225개 지방의회가 50만 점 넘는 미술품을 갖고 있지만 대부분 창고에 있다고 BBC가 밝혔어요.

bites.title: Pianist Lim Yunchan and composer Lee Hanurij win big prizes
bites.en: Pianist Lim Yunchan won Apple Music's album of the year. His friend, the composer Lee Hanurij, aged 20, won first prize in composition at the 80th Geneva competition. Both wins came within hours.
bites.ko: 피아니스트 임윤찬이 애플 뮤직 올해의 앨범을, 친구 작곡가 이한울이 제네바 콩쿠르 작곡 1위를 같은 때에 차지했어요.

bites.title: Chemical traces hint at poisoned weapons 125,000 years ago
bites.en: A study found that people in Arabia 125,000 years ago used advanced technology. They made composite hunting weapons, processed plant fibers and may have used poison to hunt.
bites.ko: 12만 5천 년 전 아라비아 사람들이 복합 사냥 무기를 만들고 독을 썼을 수도 있다는 연구가 나왔어요.

bites.title: Andrew Garfield to get a Palm Springs award
bites.en: Andrew Garfield will be honored with the Spotlight Award. The prize is part of the Palm Springs International Film Awards.
bites.ko: 앤드루 가필드가 팜스프링스 국제영화상에서 스포트라이트 상을 받아요.

bites.title: Two documentaries lead Cinema Eye nominations
bites.en: The Cinema Eye Honors announced documentary nominations. 'American Doctor' and 'You Can See Everything' are at the top of the list.
bites.ko: 시네마 아이 다큐멘터리 후보에서 '아메리칸 닥터'와 '유 캔 시 에브리싱'이 앞섰어요.

bites.title: School Spirits gets a fourth season
bites.en: 'School Spirits' will return for Season 4. Milo Manheim and Jennifer Tilly will come back. Maria Dizzia moves up to series regular.
bites.ko: '스쿨 스피리츠' 시즌4가 나오고 밀로 맨하임 등이 돌아와요.

bites.title: Spotify picks rookie group Lngshot
bites.en: Spotify has chosen the new boy group Lngshot for its Radar Korea program. The program supports new musicians. The group has four members.
bites.ko: 스포티파이가 신인 4인조 보이그룹 렁샷을 신인 지원 프로그램 '레이더 코리아' 아티스트로 뽑았어요.

bites.title: Phoebe Bridgers adds 25 more tour dates
bites.en: Phoebe Bridgers is extending her Lost Tour. She added 25 more dates in North America in 2027, Variety reports.
bites.ko: 피비 브리저스가 2027년 북미 공연 25회를 더 추가했어요.

bites.title: Xbox turns 25 and tries to start over again
bites.en: The first Xbox launched on November 15, 2001. It took on a market led by Sony and Nintendo. Twenty-five years later, The Verge says Xbox is in a similar position and is trying to reinvent itself again.
bites.ko: 엑스박스가 25주년을 맞아 다시 변신을 시도한다고 해요.

bites.title: X launches its own clipping tool
bites.en: X has launched a clipping feature. Clipping means cutting long videos into short clips that can go viral. The company hopes it will boost engagement from influencers.
bites.ko: X가 긴 영상을 짧게 잘라 퍼뜨리는 '클리핑' 기능을 내놨어요. 인플루언서 참여를 늘리려는 거예요.

bites.title: Actor Irma P Hall dies at 91
bites.en: Irma P Hall has died at the age of 91. The Guardian calls her a veteran actor and the star of The Ladykillers.
bites.ko: '더 레이디킬러스'의 배우 어마 P. 홀이 91세로 세상을 떠났어요.

bites.title: Man United sack Carrick within 15 games
bites.en: BBC Sport looks at the chaos around Michael Carrick at Manchester United. He went from a two-year deal to being sacked within 15 games.
bites.ko: 맨유가 두 해 계약을 한 카릭 감독을 15경기 안에 해임했어요.

bites.title: Crystal Palace sack manager Sage
bites.en: Crystal Palace have sacked Pierre Sage after 16 games. BBC Sport says Frank is in advanced talks to take over.
bites.ko: 크리스털 팰리스가 16경기 만에 사지 감독을 해임했고 프랭크와 협상 중이에요.

bites.title: Robertson matches Scotland's cap record
bites.en: Andy Robertson has matched the Scotland cap record. The Guardian says he paid tribute to Kenny Dalglish.
bites.ko: 스코틀랜드의 로버트슨이 대표팀 최다 출전 기록과 같아졌어요.

bites.title: Pete Crow-Armstrong has an MVP-worthy year
bites.en: ESPN tells the inside story of Pete Crow-Armstrong's MVP-worthy season. One quote in the title says, 'It's like a light switch went on.'
bites.ko: ESPN이 MVP급 시즌을 보낸 크로우암스트롱의 이야기를 다뤘어요.

bites.title: Embiid questionable, LeBron out vs. Raptors
bites.en: ESPN reports that 76ers player Joel Embiid is questionable with a foot problem. LeBron James is out with a back problem against the Raptors.
bites.ko: 엠비드는 발 때문에 출전이 불투명하고 르브론은 허리로 결장해요.

bites.title: Korea passes 20 million visitors
bites.en: Korea has welcomed more than 20 million foreign visitors this year, the culture ministry said. It is the first time the country has crossed that mark. It first reached 10 million 14 years ago.
bites.ko: 올해 한국 방문 외국인이 처음으로 2000만 명을 넘었다고 문체부가 밝혔어요. 1000만 명을 처음 넘은 지 14년 만이에요.

bites.title: Tasmania tells tourists to stay away
bites.en: Tasmania says it is not really for tourists. Some people think this is clever reverse psychology. The idea comes from research showing that tourists hate themselves.
bites.ko: 타즈메이니아가 '관광객용 섬이 아니다'라며 오지 말라고 해요. 일부는 역심리 마케팅이라고 봐요.

gloss.meaning: 일부러 반대로 말해 끌어당기는 심리 기법

bites.title: Mexican chef wins ramyeon contest
bites.en: A Mexican cook and content creator called Borrecito won a Korean ramyun contest. He had never planned to enter or visit Korea. His winning recipe used beer, chipotle and Shin Ramyun.
bites.ko: 멕시코 요리사 보레시토가 맥주와 치폴레를 넣은 신라면 레시피로 한국 라면 대회에서 1등을 했어요.

bites.title: Understanding therapy-speak
bites.en: Words from the therapist's chair now appear in daily talk, such as 'You're triggering me'. The BBC offers a guide for parents on what teenagers mean.
bites.ko: '넌 날 트리거해' 같은 상담실 말이 일상 대화에 퍼졌어요. BBC가 부모를 위한 해설을 냈어요.

bites.title: Early Black Friday deals start
bites.en: Black Friday is on November 27. Retailers have already started early discounts on tech products. Prices are rising in many places.
bites.ko: 블랙프라이데이는 11월 27일인데, 벌써 전자제품 조기 할인이 시작됐어요.

bites.title: US students rally for Starbucks workers
bites.en: Students are holding rallies at more than 40 US campuses on Thursday. They support Starbucks baristas who want better pay and conditions. The workers criticize stalled contract talks.
bites.ko: 미국 40여 개 대학 캠퍼스에서 학생들이 스타벅스 바리스타의 처우 개선 요구를 지지하는 집회를 열어요.

bites.title: Smith College reverses childcare closure
bites.en: Smith College quickly reversed its decision to close its childcare center. The backlash shows a growing concern about childcare on campus.
bites.ko: 스미스 칼리지가 캠퍼스 어린이집 폐쇄 결정을 반발에 곧바로 되돌렸어요. 캠퍼스 육아 시설 문제가 커지고 있어요.

bites.title: MIT football captain talks about balance
bites.en: Dominic Hess is an Academic All-American defensive back and co-captain of MIT's football team. He says football keeps him grounded and inspired.
bites.ko: MIT 풋볼 공동 주장 도미닉 헤스가 학업과 운동을 함께하며 풋볼이 마음을 단단하게 해 준다고 말해요.

bites.title: Retractions of old papers are rising
bites.en: Nature reports that retractions of old papers are on the rise. It asks when bad science should be culled from the literature.
bites.ko: 네이처가 오래된 논문의 철회가 늘고 있다며, 잘못된 연구를 언제 학계 기록에서 없애야 하는지 물어요.

bites.title: Women often miss author credit
bites.en: Nature asks whether women are named as authors or only acknowledged in research. It reports that women are not gaining full credit for their work.
bites.ko: 네이처가 연구에서 여성이 저자가 아닌 '감사의 글' 수준으로만 언급돼 충분한 공로를 못 받는다고 짚어요.

bites.title: Pentagon ends Brown and Naval War College link
bites.en: The Department of Defense has ended a partnership between Brown University and the Naval War College, Inside Higher Ed reports.
bites.ko: 미국 국방부가 브라운대와 해군전쟁대학의 협력 관계를 끝냈다고 인사이드 하이어 에드가 전해요.

bites.title: MIT welcomes seven new computing faculty
bites.en: The MIT Schwarzman College of Computing welcomed seven new faculty members for 2026. They work in core computing and in shared roles with other fields.
bites.ko: MIT 슈워츠먼 컴퓨팅대학이 2026년 신임 교수 7명을 맞았어요. 핵심 컴퓨팅과 타 분야 겸임 역할을 맡아요.
